purpose: Falsify or provisionally support one causal explanation for the remaining V155 low-load QPR deficit with only three diagnostic NSESche runs. V156 changes the placement frontier from parents-completed to parents-scheduled while preserving the complete V155 queue-8 scoring router, SRPT order, solver, formulas, HPA, tapes, metrics, and policy-independent reference construction.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_historical_frozen_blo: retain unchanged and do not rerun
paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_high_historical_frozen_block: retain unchanged and do not rerun

frozen_evidence.v149_low_profile_summary: The native OCS parents-scheduled pipeline frontier nearly eliminated queue area but did not preserve complete-block throughput or QPR. It is causal evidence for frontier effects, not a candidate source and not a seed-selection pool.
frozen_evidence.prior_pipeline_warning: Earlier dependency-pipeline work showed that enlarging the frontier can increase congestion and cost. Therefore V156 is a three-seed falsification screen and cannot advance merely because one seed improves.

adaptive_diagnostic_disclosure.selection_basis: After the sealed V155 reveal, E09, E18, and E20 were the three largest finite-only QPR deficits versus the preregistered OCS comparator: -0.08356428881363244, -0.031325238271154576, and -0.014165237537827946.
adaptive_diagnostic_disclosure.why_three: These seeds account for the dominant revealed QPR tail and provide a low-cost falsification of the pipeline-frontier mechanism before spending seventeen additional NSESche runs. A passing diagnostic only authorizes a separately committed complete-cohort training plan.

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only the three frozen V155 E09, E18, and E20 rows with the three V156 rows, retain the other seventeen V155 rows, and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_mean_gate: hybrid 20-seed mean must be strictly greater than Orion 1.4741 requests/ms
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_equivalent_three_seed_sum_gat: V156 E09+E18+E20 throughput must be strictly greater than 4.042 requests/ms
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: hybrid must have at least 12 of 20 strictly positive paired differences versus Orion; because the retained seventeen contribute 10 wins, V156 must win at least 2 of 3 diagnostic pairs
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both finite-only and zero-completed-as-zero hybrid 20-seed means must be strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_equivalent_three_seed_sum_gate: for the currently all-finite cohort, V156 E09+E18+E20 QPR must be strictly greater than 0.187264280342794
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: hybrid must retain at least 12 of 20 strictly positive paired differences versus OCS
diagnostic_selection_rule.coverage_gate: finite-only QPR must be finite for all 20 hybrid rows; zero-completed-as-zero retains all 20
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every throughput, QPR, coverage, paired, and mechanism gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain the three valid diagnostic runs, retire the pipeline-frontier candidate, do not run the remaining seventeen seeds, and continue first-principles mechanism analysis
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed plan that runs V156 on the remaining seventeen E01-E20 seeds, reuses these three valid rows without rerun, and evaluates the complete fixed training cohort
